tests.name: client-side re-hash of all 14 mesh vertex+index arrays vs the recomputed fingerprints

tests.name: two instances from the shared asset: change A leaves B bit-identical; geometry SHARED; wrappers/conversions independent
tests.measuredQuantity: authored+composed TRS deep-equality before/after; BufferGeometry object identity across instances; conversion-application count
tests.independentSourceOfTruth: trsDeepEqual (exact TRS comparison) + THREE object identity (===) of the geometry cache
tests.whyNonCircular: the app builder path is executed as the app uses it; the independence predicate compares B against its own pre-change snapshot

tests.name: diagnostics fields present and honest; dPVS heuristic ledger reports imported vs visible with reasons (9/5 preserved)
tests.measuredQuantity: buildDiagnosticsModel + computeVisibilityLedger + buildInspectorRows outputs vs the measured IR accounting
tests.independentSourceOfTruth: the phase-2 measured accounting (62+4=66, 14 meshes, 9 TEXTURE_NAME_BOUND + 5 UNTEXTURED, 5 dPVS-named meshes)
tests.whyNonCircular: the diagnostics/ledger builders are fed the SAME asset and their outputs are compared against independently pinned counts — a hidden mesh MUST appear as an exclusion, never as a silent pass
